# StartupBar

> A free traffic-exchange network for software founders. Add one line of code to your site and a 36px bar promotes another verified startup — yours gets featured back on theirs.

StartupBar lets software founders grow together by embedding a lightweight widget on their site. The widget shows a rotating startup from the network, and in return your startup appears on other members' sites. All impressions and clicks are tracked, and founders get a dashboard with analytics, network rank, and click-through stats.

## Integration

To embed the widget, add this script tag to your site's `<head>` (or anywhere in the page). Replace `YOUR_STARTUP_ID` with the ID shown on your dashboard after approval:

```html
<script async src="https://startupbar.co/widget/loader.js" data-startup-id="YOUR_STARTUP_ID"></script>
```

Notes:

- The bar renders in a sandboxed iframe at the top of the page (36px tall) and never blocks page content.
- Theme is auto-detected (light/dark) from your site. Force it with `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"`.
- Visitors can dismiss the bar for their session; nothing is stored beyond a per-session ID used to de-duplicate impressions.
- Works on any site or framework — plain HTML, React, Next.js, Webflow, Framer, etc. No npm package needed.
- Installation is verified automatically; the dashboard shows whether the widget is detected and last seen.

## How it works

1. Apply with your startup name, URL, and one-liner.
2. Once approved, copy your script tag from the dashboard and install it.
3. Your site displays other members' startups; the network displays yours in return.
4. Delivery is reciprocity-weighted: the more impressions your site contributes, the more exposure your startup receives.

## Eligibility

Accepted: live software products, SaaS, developer tools, AI apps, and indie/founder-built web products with a working public website and a real landing page.

Rejected: sites that are not live yet, parked or placeholder pages, adult content, gambling, crypto pump/airdrop schemes, scams or MLM, link farms, pirated content, and anything illegal or unsafe. Sites that remove the widget after joining are removed from the network.

## Dashboard

After approval, founders get a dashboard at [startupbar.co/dashboard](/dashboard) with impressions served, impressions contributed, clicks, click-through rate, network rank, and 12-month trends.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the traffic-exchange network, how the widget works, and how to join.
- [Apply](/apply): Submit your startup to join the network. Provide your startup name, website URL, and a one-liner description.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Live ranking of all startups in the network by total impressions and clicks, with real-time stats.
- [Network](/network): Explore the full network of startups, browse by category, and see recent activity across the exchange.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How StartupBar collects, uses, and protects founder and visitor data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Rules for participating in the traffic exchange, application requirements, and acceptable use.

## Optional

- [Widget Bar](/widget/bar): The embeddable widget itself. Rendered inside an iframe on members' sites to display rotating startup promotions.
